prose: Basis: the Techmeme summary of the piece; the Financial Times article itself could not be fetched. The FT profiles Alexandr Wang, the 29-year-old leading Meta's Superintelligence Labs, describing him through sources as 'an operator' who had 'all' of Mark Zuckerberg's support during the company's AI revamp.
The profile is notable for its framing of Wang as a potential successor to Zuckerberg, an unusually direct succession signal for a company Meta's size.
highlights: FT profile of Alexandr Wang, 29, head of Meta Superintelligence Labs
Sources call him 'an operator' with 'all' of Zuckerberg's support in the AI revamp
Touted as a potential successor to Mark Zuckerberg
Basis: Techmeme summary; FT original not retrievable
